description: babel-jest instruments only the files under the process's working directory (`cwd: transformOptions.config.cwd`, babel-jest 30.5.2 `src/index.ts` L69-L70: "files outside `cwd` will not be instrumented"), not those under `rootDir` (T8.10, B23b): the runner starts in `sub/`, below the root, as `cd packages/a && jest` with `rootDir: '../..'` does. `sub/inside.ts` is counted; `src/add.ts`, which the same test loads, is not. The `json` and `text-summary` reports, as Jest wrote them (Istanbul's per-file `hash`, a digest that holds the work directory's path, masked by key). Read by `provino`'s `jest-coverage.test.ts`.
